changes.before: Labor market conditions have improved further; the unemployment rate has declined notably in recent months but remains elevated.
changes.after: Labor market conditions have improved in recent months; the unemployment rate has declined but remains elevated.
Despite some signs of improvement, the housing sector remains depressed.

changes.before: Inflation has been subdued in recent months, although prices of crude oil and gasoline have increased lately.
changes.after: Inflation has picked up somewhat, mainly reflecting higher prices of crude oil and gasoline.

parsed.rationale: The statement mixes slightly firmer inflation and growth descriptions with softer labor-market wording, dropped mention of eased financial strains, and a more benign oil-price framing. The policy rate, the late-2014 guidance and the balance-sheet language are unchanged, so the net signal is roughly neutral.

spans.quote: Labor market conditions have improved further; the unemployment rate has declined notably in recent months but remains elevated.
Inflation has been subdued in recent months, although prices of crude oil and gasoline have increased lately.
The Committee expects moderate economic growth over coming quarters and consequently anticipates
Strains in global financial markets have eased, though they continue to pose significant downside risks to the economic outlook.
The recent increase in oil and gasoline prices will push up inflation temporarily
Labor market conditions have improved in recent months; the unemployment rate has declined but remains elevated.
Despite some signs of improvement, the housing sector remains depressed.
Inflation has picked up somewhat, mainly reflecting higher prices of crude oil and gasoline.
The Committee expects economic growth to remain moderate over coming quarters and then to pick up gradually.
Strains in global financial markets continue to pose significant downside risks to the economic outlook.
The increase in oil and gasoline prices earlier this year is expected to affect inflation only temporarily
